Exact rule text confirmed from STRATEGY_TO_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.csv against Replay_Verification_Contract_LOCKED.md lines 99-100 (section 'Admissibility of a PASS (LOCKED)'): R0051 -- 'A replay PASS may not close a data-quality finding, release a quarantine, dismiss a corporate-action candidate, or satisfy a continuity check.'; R0052 -- 'Where an audit claim requires correctness, the admissible evidence is independent -- verified event terms, source reconciliation, or exchange-published facts -- not a replay verdict.' root_cause_and_implementation: Both predicates were guard gaps, not executable defects; the existing implementation already conformed to both rules, confirmed by direct consumer-surface reading before any test was written. R0051: the existing corpus guard (B18ReplayAdmissibilityBoundaryTest's forbidden() prose scan) only reads sentences in documents and code comments, so a real consumer enacting the prohibition as executable behaviour -- a call, not a claim -- would cross the existing guard silently. A new static consumer guard, B18ReplayVerdictConsumerBoundaryTest, was added: it derives a positive-locator, fail-closed enumeration of every file under app/ that reads a replay verdict field (13 files today, matching F-015's own review of the replay/backfill/evidence/command surfaces plus the result repository), and scans each reviewed file for the rule's four prohibited actions using bidirectional verb/noun proximity patterns (verb-then-subject or subject-then-verb, since a real call site as often reads $this->quarantine->release(...) as releaseQuarantine(...)). No production code was changed. R0052: forbidden() carried no pattern of its own for this predicate at all. A dedicated pattern was added to the existing array, deliberately phrased from the rule's own named alternative (independent/admissible evidence) rather than from the paraphrase F-MD-B18-A002-015's own gap-table entry already quotes verbatim as a named example -- reusing that paraphrase would have made the new pattern fire on F-015's own live, unexcluded finding document, a false positive against the very record describing the gap. No production code was changed for this predicate either.
